Adv. No.: IIITP/ECE/ 0002 Date: 06/11/2026
Advertisement for the Post of Junior Research Fellow (JRF) in ISRO
Sponsored Project under RESPOND Programme
Applications are invited from eligible Indian nationals for the position of Junior Research
Fellow (JRF) to work on a purely temporary research project sponsored by the Indian Space
Research Organisation (ISRO).
Particulars Details
Title of the High Data Rate Channel Codec Architecture for Free Space Classical RF
Project and Optical Communication
Project Dr. Dheeraj Dubey, Assistant Professor, Department of Electronics and
Investigator (PI) Communication Engineering, IIIT Pune
Position Junior Research Fellow (JRF)
No. of Positions One (01)
Funding Agency Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO)
Area of Research Classical RF Communication, Free Space Optical (FSO)
Communication, Channel Coding, Error Control Coding, Wireless
Communication, Optical Wireless Communication, Communication
Systems
Fellowship ₹37,000/- per month + 30% HRA (as per ISRO norms)
Project Duration Two (02) Years
Place of Work Indian Institute of Information Technology Pune

Nature of The Junior Research Fellow (JRF) will be appointed for an initial period
Appointment of six months. Based on satisfactory performance, the appointment will
be extended for the remaining duration of the project (up to two years),
subject to the availability of project funds and institute/ISRO guidelines.
Essential Qualifications
Applicants should possess:
Postgraduate Degree in Basic Science OR Graduate/Postgraduate Degree in a
Professional Course selected through a process described through any one of the
following:
(a) Scholars who are selected through National Eligibility Tests such as CSIR-UGC NET
(including Lectureship/Assistant Professorship), or GATE.
OR
(b) The selection process through National Level Examinations conducted by Central
Government Departments and their Agencies/Institutions such as DST, DBT, DAE, DOS,
DRDO, MoE (formerly MHRD), ICAR, ICMR, IITs, IISc, IISER, etc.
Desirable Qualifications
Preference will be given to candidates having one or more of the following:
• Strong background in Digital Communication, Wireless Communication, Information
Theory, Channel Coding and Error Control Coding.
• Knowledge of Optical Communication and Free Space Optical (FSO) Communication.
• Experience with MATLAB, Python, or similar simulation/programming tools.
• Knowledge of communication system design and performance analysis.
• Good programming, analytical and technical writing skills.
• Research publications in relevant areas will be an added advantage.
Job Responsibilities
The selected candidate will be expected to:
• Conduct research related to high-speed channel coding for classical RF and Free Space
Optical communication systems.

• Design, simulate and evaluate communication algorithms.
• Develop software models and validate system performance.
• Assist in preparation of project reports, technical documents and research publications.
• Participate in meetings and other project-related activities assigned by the PI.
How to Apply
Interested candidates should submit their application through email in a single PDF file
containing the following documents:
1. Duly filled Application Form (At the end of advertisement).
2. Updated Curriculum Vitae (CV).
3. Self-attested copies of all educational certificates and mark sheets.
4. GATE/CSIR-UGC NET score card.
5. Experience certificates (if any).
6. List of publications along with copies of the first page of each publication (if any).
7. Any other supporting documents relevant to the project.
8. Undertaking (Annexure I)
Application Form Submission Link
Candidates are required to fill and upload the duly completed Application Form along with
all supporting documents through the Google Form provided for the application.
Candidates may also send the completed application form and supporting documents to
dheeraj@iiitp.ac.in. The email should be sent with the subject: "Application for JRF
Position – ISRO RESPOND Project"
Google Form Link: https://forms.gle/18NDdn1m6TyAcRUUA
For any queries regarding the position, candidates may contact:

Important Dates (Tentative)
Event Tentative Date
Last Date for Submission of Application
25-11-2026
Intimation to Shortlisted Candidates 28-10-2026
Date of Interview
07-12-2026
Only shortlisted candidates will be informed through email regarding the interview schedule.
Selection Procedure
• Applications will be screened based on eligibility and suitability for the project.
• Only shortlisted candidates will be invited for the interview.
• The interview may be conducted in offline mode at IIIT Pune or through online mode,
depending on administrative requirements.
• The final selection will be based on the candidate's academic credentials, research
aptitude, technical competence and interview performance.
General Terms & Conditions
1. The position is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project.
2. Mere fulfillment of the minimum eligibility criteria does not guarantee shortlisting for
the interview.
3. IIIT Pune reserves the right to restrict the number of candidates called for interview
based on academic performance and relevant experience.
4. The Institute reserves the right not to fill the advertised position if suitable candidates
are not found.

5. The selected candidate shall not claim any regular appointment in IIIT Pune by virtue
of this fellowship.
6. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.
7. Original documents shall have to be produced for verification at the time of
interview/joining.
8. Incomplete applications or applications received after the due date will not be
considered.
9. Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification.
10. The decision of IIIT Pune regarding selection shall be final and binding.
Dr. Dheeraj Dubey
Project Investigator (PI), dheeraj@iiitp.ac.in , 8840677530
Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering
Indian Institute of Information Technology Pune
